description: This file defines a CustomTool class implementing INode, which manages custom tools within a flow-based system. It includes methods for listing tools from a database and initializing a tool with specific configurations.

classes.name: CustomTool_Tools
classes.description: A class implementing INode to handle custom tools, including listing available tools and initializing a tool instance with specific parameters.

methods.name: loadMethods
methods.description: Asynchronously loads a list of available tools from the database based on search options.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes a DynamicStructuredTool instance with selected tool data and custom configurations.
